hero.name: Vedant Misra
hero.bio: I build products for people technology forgot. AI is racing ahead in labs; most of the world hasn't felt it yet. I care about closing that gap — why something should exist, who it's for, and whether it feels obvious to use.

reading.title: High Output Management
reading.author: Andy Grove
reading.note: grove's case for management as leverage: a manager's output is the output of every team under them. reading it for how it thinks in systems, not just people.
